passages.provision_quote: Any large online platform shall develop and implement procedures for the use of state-of-the-art techniques to identify and remove materially deceptive content if all of the following conditions are met:
passages.note: Enacted bill Berman authored legally requires platforms to identify and remove materially deceptive election content within specified windows, with a separate labeling duty for content outside that window.

rows.reasoning: AB 2655 (2023-2024), authored and signed by Berman as its named author, legally requires large online platforms to 'identify and remove materially deceptive content' tied to elections within specified pre- and post-election windows, matching the rung text 'legally require platforms to remove false information.' The Act's separate labeling duty applies only to a distinct category of content falling outside the removal window, so it does not establish a label-instead-of-removal position and does not displace the removal mandate as his position.
